plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Economics AA-T Degree (Full Time)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 09, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7361/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Total Units 60 = 14+14+16+16 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). MATH 400: the map shows placement-process eligibility ('through the placement process'); students working on this major are placed directly into MATH 400 (see a counselor about preparation or support courses) — not a course prerequisite. The math courses shown represent one option; they may need to be adjusted depending on the transfer institution and major. Many universities require students to take their entire math series at the same institution. The Area 5C (Science Lab) course must correspond with either the Area 5A or Area 5B course and must be taken concurrently or after the lecture course. Transferable elective courses: any elective courses numbered 300-499, or having a 4-digit number starting with C. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. The CSU system requires every bachelor's degree student to be knowledgeable about the U.S. Constitution, American history, and state and local government (American Institutions); students can complete this requirement at ARC before transferring. See ASSIST.ORG for transfer requirements of the destination institution.
